card.name: Sodium names, ahead of potassium
card.fires_on: Inside the word sodium (e.g. SODI-UM) or just after it in salt lists, at points where potassium or magnesium comes next. Seen in drug names, electrolyte solutions and bowel-prep text.

modes.label: Inside sodium
modes.description: Partway through the word sodium, often in capitalised drug names.
modes.example: THE TOXICITY OF FOSCARNET SOD<<I>>UM INJECTION MAY BE INCREASED

modes.label: Joiner before potassium
modes.description: A comma, "and" or the start of potassium or magnesium right after sodium in a list of salts.
modes.example: Sodium Sulfate,<< Pot>>assium Sulfate and Magnesium S

card.writes: It lowers the odds of sodium and other metal names and raises the odds of "pot" (potassium).
card.plain: It marks the spot in a sodium-and-potassium salt list where potassium is the likely next word.
